welcome_message: A data product for Databricks: dlt lands the data, dbt shapes it, one job runs both.

project_name.description: The project's name, also the bundle's. Letters, digits, '-' and '_'
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: A name starts with a letter and has only letters, digits, '-' and '_'.

package_name.description: The Python package's name (the project's name with underscores)
package_name.pattern_match_failure_message: A package name is lowercase letters, digits and '_', starting with a letter.

catalog.description: The Unity Catalog catalog the product loads into

warehouse_id.description: The id of the SQL warehouse to load through (leave empty to give it at deploy)

secret_scope.description: A secret scope for the sources' secrets (leave empty for none yet)

include_dbt.description: Shape the data with dbt, as a second task of the job

include_lely.description: Deploy with lely: a reviewed plan on every pull request, applied on merge

include_caland.description: Keep the secrets with caland, from a mise task

success_message:
{{.project_name}} is written. Next:

  cd {{.project_name}}
  mise install && mise run dev        # the example pipeline, into a local DuckDB file
  mise run deploy && mise run job      # the job on your workspace, dev target

The README has the rest.
